body:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/e3e9d48d2dedd5670aa1b80dbdb874c65201f906.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Important[/b][/h2][list][*][p]As a result of engine updates, the download file size for this update will be larger than normal.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Known Issues[/b][/h3][list][*][p]We are aware of an issue causing The Walking Dead theme to continue playing despite turning off the Copyrighted Music Setting. This is being investigated.[/p][/*][*][p]To prevent potential connectivity issues when in cross-play with other platforms, it is recommended that Nintendo users download the latest Nintendo Switch firmware version available.[/p][/*][*][p]Killers and Survivors may be slowed down when going up the right-hand side of any staircase.[/p][/*][*][p]Michonne Grimes' hair may glow bright white or yellow when close to a light source.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]Content[/b][/h2][h3][b]NEW SURVIVOR: RICK GRIMES[/b][/h3][p][b]New Perk: Apocalyptic Ingenuity[/b][/p][list][*][p]After unlocking or rummaging through [b]2/2/2 [/b]chests, press the Ability Button 1 for [b]4/4/4 seconds[/b] next to a broken pallet to build a fragile pallet.[/p][/*][*][p]You see the auras of broken pallets within[b] 24/28/32 meters.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Fragile pallets are destroyed after being dropped.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]New Perk: Come and Get Me![/b][/p][list][*][p]After unhooking a Survivor, while crouched and idle, press the Ability Button 1 to make injured and dying Survivors within [b]24/24/24 meters [/b]leave no scratch marks or pools of blood or make grunts of pain for [b]10/12.5/15 seconds.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]You scream and the Killer sees your aura for [b]5/5/5 seconds[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p][b]New Perk: Teamwork: Toughen Up[/b][/p][list][*][p]When another Survivor pallet-stuns or blinds the Killer while you are injured and within [b]24/24/24 meters[/b], your grunts of pain, scratch marks and pools of blood are reduced by [b]100/100/100%[/b] for[b] 20/25/30 seconds[/b].[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]NEW SURVIVOR: MICHONNE GRIMES[/b][/h3][p][b]New Perk: Conviction[/b][/p][list][*][p]After you have healed [b]1/1/1 Survivor[/b], while downed with at least [b]25/25/25%[/b] recovery, press Ability Button 2 to recover instantly.[/p][/*][*][p]You gain Broken, then are downed after [b]20/25/30 seconds[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p][b]New Perk: Last Stand[/b][/p][list][*][p]After spending [b]120/105/90 seconds[/b] in the Killer's Terror Radius while not in chase, when you fast-vault, stun the Killer for [b]3/3/3 seconds[/b] if they are within [b]2.5/2.5/2.5 meters[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Then, this perk is disabled for the rest of the trial.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]
New Perk: Teamwork: Throw Down[/b][/p][list][*][p]When you pallet-stun or blind the Killer, other injured Survivors within [b]24/24/24 meters[/b] gain Endurance and see the Killer's aura for [b]6/8/10 seconds[/b].[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]KILLER UPDATES[/b][/h3][p][b]The Executioner[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased Punishment of the Damned's range to [b]10 meters [/b][i](was 8)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Increased maximum Rites of Judgement duration to [b]10 seconds [/b][i](was 5)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Rites of Judgement trail lifetime to [b]90 seconds [/b][i](was 75)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased Rites of Judgement movement speed to [b]4.2m/s[/b] [i](was 4.4)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]The inputs for Rites of Judgement, Punishment of the Damned, and sending a Survivor to a cage can now be held, starting the action as soon as it becomes available.[/p][/*][*][p]Survivors who are rescued from a cage now gain [b]10% Haste [/b]and Endurance[b] [/b]for [b]10 seconds[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Bloodpoint score for rescuing a Survivor from a cage to [b]2000[/b] [i](was 550)[/i].[/p][/*][/list][p][b]The Executioner's Add-Ons[/b][/p][list][*][p]Lead Ring [i](Rework)[/i]: Now increases Punishment of the Damned's range by [b]25% [/b]and decreases its width by [b]25%.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Dead Butterfly [i](Rework)[/i]: Now increases Rites of Judgement's recharge rate by [b]10%[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Black Strap [i](Rework)[/i]: Now decreases Punishment of the Damned's range by [b]25%[/b] and increases its width by [b]25%[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Copper Ring: Now increases maximum duration of Rites of Judgement by [b]5 seconds[/b] [i](was 1)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Cinderella Music Box [i](Rework)[/i]: Now decreases Punishment of the Damned's cooldown by [b]10%.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Forgotten Video Tape [i](Rework)[/i]: Now increases the speed at which Punishment of the Damned travels by [b]10%.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Wax Doll: Now increases Punishment of the Damned's range by [b]5%[/b] [i](was 12.5%)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Spearhead [i](Rework)[/i]: Now reveals the aura of the rescuer when a Survivor is saved from a cage for [b]8 seconds[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Leopard-Print Fabric [i](Rework)[/i]: Now decreases the duration of stuns while using Rites of Judgement by [b]15%[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Mannequin Foot [i](Rework)[/i]: Now causes Rites of Judgement trails to inflict Exhausted for [b]10 seconds[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Valtiel Sect Photograph [i](Rework)[/i]: Now decreases your Terror Radius by [b]2 meters [/b]for each Survivor affected by Torment.[/p][/*][*][p]Burning Man Painting [i](Rework)[/i]: Now reveals the auras of Survivors within [b]3 meters [/b]for [b]6 seconds [/b]upon missing a Punishment of the Damned attack.[/p][/*][*][p]Tablet of the Oppressor [i](Rework)[/i]: Now grants Undetectable while using Rites of Judgement.[/p][/*][*][p]Misty Day, Remains of Judgement [i](Rework)[/i]: Now reveals the auras of Survivors injured by Punishment of the Damned for [b]8 seconds[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Scarlet Egg [i](Rework)[/i]: Now causes Survivors inflicted by Torment to spawn Rites of Judgement trails when they sprint. These trails last [b]5 seconds[/b]. You no longer see the auras of Rites of Judgement trails.[/p][/*][*][p]Rust-colored Egg [i](Rework)[/i]: Now causes Punishment of the Damned hits to replenish Rites of Judgement's charge by [b]30%[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Lost Memories Book [i](Rework)[/i]: Now causes Survivors injured by Punishment of the Damned to become Oblivious[b] [/b]for [b]80 seconds[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Obsidian Goblet [i](Rework)[/i]: Now allows Punishment of the Damned to destroy pallets and breakable walls. Increases Punishment of the Damned's cooldown by [b]20%.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Iridescent Seal of Metatron [i](Rework)[/i]: Now decreases Punishment of the Damned's range by [b]50%[/b]. Punishment of the Damned's range increases by creating Rites of Judgement trails, up to a maximum of [b]200%[/b]. This resets when Punishment of the Damned hits a Survivor.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]The Clown[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased Haste effect of Afterpiece Antidote to [b]12%[/b] [i](was 10%)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased the time it takes for Afterpiece Antidote gas clouds to activate to [b]1 second [/b][i](was 2)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased the Hindered effect of Afterpiece Tonic to [b]14%[/b] [i](was 15%)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased the Hindered effect linger time from Afterpiece Tonic gas clouds to [b]1 second [/b][i](was 2)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Increased movement speed while reloading to [b]2.3m/s[/b] [i](was 1.61)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased the time it takes to reload to [b]2.5 seconds[/b] [i](was 3)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]The inputs for reloading and charging a throw can now be held, starting the action as soon as it becomes available.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]The Clown's Add-Ons[/b][/p][list][*][p]VHS Porn [i](Rework)[/i]: Now increases the size and spread of Afterpiece Tonic gas clouds by [b]10%.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Flask of Bleach: Now increases the Hindered penalty from Intoxication by [b]2% [/b][i](was 4%)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Smelly Inner Soles: Now increases movement speed while reloading by [b]15%[/b] [i](was 66%)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Cigar Box: Now reveals auras within [b]6 meters [/b][i](was 16)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Ether 15 Vol%: Now increases the duration of Intoxication by [b]0.5 seconds [/b][i](was 1)[/i].[/p][/*][/list][p][b]The Pig[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased Ambush movement speed to [b]7.1m/s[/b] [i](was 6.9)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Increased crouched movement speed to [b]4.0m/s[/b] [i](was 3.8)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased the time it takes to crouch & un-crouch to [b]0.8 seconds [/b][i](was 1)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the rate at which the Terror Radius fades when crouching to [b]0.33 [/b][i](was 0.25)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]The inputs for crouching and ambushing can now be held, starting the action as soon as it becomes available.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Bloodpoint score for escaping a Reverse Bear Trap to [b]1000 [/b][i](was 400)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Bloodpoint score for searching through a Jigsaw Box to [b]200[/b] [i](was 100)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Searching a Jigsaw Box now awards Survival points [i](was Objective)[/i].[/p][/*][/list][p][b]The Pig's Add-Ons[/b][/p][list][*][p]John's Medical File: Now increases crouched movement speed by [b]5% [/b][i](was 10%)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Last Will: Now increases Ambush speed by [b]5% [/b][i](was 6%)[/i] and increases the time to charge Ambush by [b]10% [/b][i](was 33%)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Workshop Grease: No longer decreases missed Ambush attack cooldown [i](was 10%)[/i].[/p][/*][/list][p][b]The Knight[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased max patrol path disabled)[/i].[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]NEW SURVIVOR ITEM: FOG VIAL[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Press the Use Item button to release a cloud of fog, decreasing visibility, suppressing scratch marks, auras, and Recharges over time.[/p][/*][*][p]Each Fog Vial shares the following parameters:[/p][list][*][p]Has 1 charge.[/p][/*][*][p]Has 40% opacity.[/p][/*][*][p]Has an 8-meter
